footnote_text: Common stock was acquired pursuant to a grant of restricted stock units ("RSUs"). Each RSU awarded represents a contingent right to receive, upon vesting of the unit, one share of the Issuer's common stock. || This RSU award vests in full, one year following September 23, 2026. || On June 8, 2025, the Issuer effected a one-for-fifteen reverse stock split of its common stock (the "Reverse Stock Split"). All amounts of securities listed herein have been adjusted to reflect the effect of the Reverse Stock Split.
